mapper.insert: insert into sys_oper_log (title, method, request_method, request_url, request_param, oper_user_id, oper_user_name, oper_ip, oper_time, cost_time, status, error_msg) values (#{title}, #{method}, #{requestMethod}, #{requestUrl}, #{requestParam}, #{operUserId}, #{operUserName}, #{operIp}, #{operTime}, #{costTime}, #{status}, #{errorMsg})
mapper.select: select id, title, method, request_method, request_url, request_param, oper_user_id, oper_user_name, oper_ip, oper_time, cost_time, status, error_msg from sys_oper_log where id = #{id}
